boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct academic work settings across Molloy’s JET Library and Information Commons in Rockville Centre.

cards.title: Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: JET Library, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Set up at a table for quiet group work, then use the nearby research computers, scanner, self-checkout kiosk, and reference collections as needed.
cards.short_summary: A central library workspace with tables, seating, research computers, scanning, and librarian service nearby.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists tables for studying and quiet group work, chairs and couches, 12 research computers, printers, and a scanner in the JET Library Main Reading Room.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: The JET Library is on the second floor of Kellenberg Hall at Molloy’s Rockville Centre campus; library policies say it is available to Molloy students, faculty, administrators, and staff.

cards.title: Educational Resource Center
cards.subtitle: JET Library, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Choose this room for a quieter small-group session and keep relevant curriculum, juvenile, or doctoral materials close at hand while you work.
cards.short_summary: A JET Library area designed for quiet group work beside specialized educational collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy identifies the Educational Resource Center as having tables for quiet group work and its ERC juvenile, curriculum, doctoral, and CAP 21 collections.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located on the main (first) floor of the JET Library in Kellenberg Hall. Follow library noise policies and take belongings when leaving.

cards.title: Library Instruction Room A
cards.subtitle: JET Library, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Check whether a library class is in session before settling in; when open, use a workstation for research, drafting, printing, or database work.
cards.short_summary: A computer-equipped JET Library classroom that students may use when it is not occupied by a library class.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists 20 computers and a multifunction printer in Library Instruction Room A and states that it is open to students when not in use for a library class.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located on the main (first) floor of the JET Library. Availability depends on library-class use.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: JET Library, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Bring a draft or assignment to the tables and ask for walk-in writing or subject-tutoring support while you work in the open learning area.
cards.short_summary: An open JET Library workspace combining group tables, computers, tutoring, and virtual-learning access.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists eight computers, a Virtual Learning Commons touchscreen, and tables for group work and tutoring in the Learning Commons; walk-in writing and subject tutoring is available there.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located on the main (first) floor of the JET Library. Academic Learning Services describes walk-in assistance in this space.

cards.title: Group Study Area
cards.subtitle: JET Library, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Meet collaborators at the tables, plug in devices using the available power supply, and keep the conversation at the library’s required low volume.
cards.short_summary: A JET Library collaboration area with group tables, device charging, and a microfilm/microfiche reader.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists tables for group work, a microfilm/microfiche reader, and power supply for charging laptops and devices in the Group Study Area.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located on the main (first) floor of the JET Library. Library policy requires low noise in group-learning spaces.

cards.title: Library Instruction Room B
cards.subtitle: JET Library mezzanine, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Use this computer room for focused digital work and printing; reach it by stairs to the mezzanine level and leave time for the change in floors.
cards.short_summary: A student-open mezzanine computer room with 15 computers and a multifunction printer.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists 15 computers and one multifunction printer in Library Instruction Room B and states that the room is open to students.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: This room is on the mezzanine (second) level of the JET Library, which Molloy says requires using stairs.

cards.title: Mezzanine with Circulating Collection
cards.subtitle: JET Library mezzanine, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Browse the circulating collection upstairs, then select a nearby place to read and compare sources before checking out materials at the library service point.
cards.short_summary: A named JET Library mezzanine area alongside the circulating collection for research-oriented reading.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy identifies a Mezzanine with Circulating Collection on the second level of the JET Library and lists the library’s seating and study spaces among its services.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: The mezzanine level of the JET Library requires stairs according to Molloy’s library locations page.

cards.title: Dominican Reading Room
cards.subtitle: JET Library third floor, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Take a private carrel for concentrated reading or writing, and plan around the stair-only route to the library’s third-floor study areas.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor JET Library reading room with 26 individual carrels for private study.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists 26 carrels for private study in the Dominican Reading Room on the third floor of the JET Library.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: The third-floor JET Library spaces require stairs, according to Molloy. Observe the library’s designated quiet-area zero-talking policy where posted.

cards.title: Quiet Study Room
cards.subtitle: JET Library third floor, Kellenberg Hall
cards.notes: Use one of the private carrels for silent individual work, mute devices, and avoid conversation because designated quiet areas have a zero-talking policy.
cards.short_summary: A third-floor, carrel-based private-study room in the JET Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy lists 14 carrels for private study in the Quiet Study Room on the third floor of the JET Library; its policy identifies designated quiet areas with a zero-talking rule.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: The third floor requires stairs. Molloy’s library policies designate quiet areas as zero-talking zones.

cards.title: Information Commons
cards.subtitle: Second floor, Public Square
cards.notes: Choose a computer or book a study room for collaborative work; outside reservation hours, rooms are first-come, first-served when Public Square is open.
cards.short_summary: A Public Square academic and IT space with 33 student computers, study rooms, and on-site assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: Molloy states that the Information Commons has 33 computers for student use and three study rooms with wall-mounted computers; rooms may be reserved Monday–Thursday from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. in spring and fall.
cards.source_title: Library Locations and Spaces | Molloy University
cards.access_notes: Located on the second floor of Public Square. Molloy lists Public Square hours as 7 a.m.–2 a.m. daily; study rooms are first-come, first-served outside spring/fall reservation hours.
